Cacakkasuttaraya
comprising the Uparipaṇṇāsaka, Salāyatanavagga of the Majjhimanikāya.
Pt.. with Buddhaghoṣa's C. an. Sinhalese transl. Brendiyavatta, 1896. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 707.

Caccarī
or Carcarī or Cācarī or Dharmarasāyana. Jain. Apabhram3śa. in 47 verses; by Jinadattasūri on a.'s preceptor Jinavallabhasūri; composed in the second half of 12th Cent. A. D. a. Vyāghrapura in Bāgaḍ (Vāgjaḍa) D..

.
See Apabhram3śa Sāhitya p.. 289. 361-3; also JRAS. (1940) p.. 67-69.
Pt.. with C. Apabhram3śakāvyatrayī GOS. XXXVII. p.. 1-27. also Intro. p. 114.
--C. by Jinapāla Upādhyāya.
